Class JSimGraphModel

java.lang.Object
common.definitions.CommonModel
jsimgraph.definitions.JSimGraphModel
All Implemented Interfaces:
CommonConstants, BlockingRegionDefinition, ClassDefinition, GraphRefreshable, SimulationDefinition, StationDefinition, JmodelBlockingRegionDefinition, JmodelClassDefinition, JmodelStationDefinition, JSimGraphConstants, EngineNodeConstants
public class JSimGraphModel extends CommonModel implements JmodelClassDefinition, JmodelStationDefinition, JmodelBlockingRegionDefinition, JSimGraphConstants, GraphRefreshable

Title: JMODEL-Model

Description: Main data structure used to store model definition data, to save and load model and to compile xml files for the simulator and as a bridge to connect JMODEL with JSIM and JMVA

Author:
Bertoli Marco Date: 2-giu-2005 Time: 10.27.54 Modified by Francesco D'Aquino 11/11/2005
